posts.post:
gold jewelry or silver jewelry.

there is no such thing as a person who looks good in both.
most people who say they dress for themselves are actually dressing for the people they want to impress.
if your closet is full of things that don't match, you're just hoarding, not building a wardrobe.
nothing ruins a perfectly good outfit faster than an uncomfortable pair of shoes.
there is a very specific type of woman who knows exactly what she wants the moment she enters a store.
